description: This file contains the PHP class 'Payment' which is a controller for managing payment extensions in the OpenCart admin interface. It includes methods for listing, installing, and uninstalling payment extensions, and utilizes OpenCart's MVC components such as model loading, language management, and URL generation.

classes.name: Payment
classes.description: Controller class for managing payment extensions in the OpenCart admin panel. Provides functionality for listing, installing, and uninstalling payment modules.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Default method that outputs the list of available payment extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Gathers data about available and installed payment extensions, preparing it for display in the admin view.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation of a payment extension, including permissions and registration.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation of a payment extension, removing permissions and updating the extension list.
